188:188.5.text: Tests: scope violation 403 pada ribuan kombinasi, consent revocation efektif dalam 1 detik, exposure gabungan = Σ lini, probe harian hijau, security gate hijau

189:189.1.text: Data product per lini (satu paket: schema, contract, SLA freshness, owner, access policy) → katalog pusat → konsumen dari lini lain lewat kontrak data

189:189.2.text: Federated metric store: definisi KPI (Fase 146.3) diperluas ke 30 lini → lineage otomatis ke voucher ledger → dashboard mana pun memakai definisi tunggal

189:189.3.text: Privacy-preserving analytics: agregasi kohort, differential privacy simulasi, k-anonimity check sebelum export lintas lini

189:189.4.text: Real-time & batch tiering: hot metrics real-time (ops), T+1 warehouse (finance), snapshot bulanan (konsolidasi) → biaya & latensi terkontrol

189:189.5.text: Tests: data product SLA breach alert, lineage konsisten dengan ledger, privacy check gagal menolak export, tiering tak mengubah angka konsolidasi

190:190.1.text: Group daily cockpit: revenue/cash/order/fulfillment/staffing per lini real-time + alert lintas lini → satu layar C-suite & duty officer

190:190.2.text: Exception triage: alert terklasifikasi (money, safety, customer, compliance) → owner otomatis → SLA respons → eskalasi → closeout dengan bukti

190:190.3.text: Daily/weekly cadence: close hari lintas lini (resto, AV, retail, hotel) → ringkasan terkonsolidasi → variance root-cause otomatis (perencanaan vs aktual)

190:190.4.text: Tests: alert duplikat tergabung, SLA eskalasi deterministik, close-day lintas lini Σ = ledger, query budget cockpit ≤ ambang

191:191.1.text: ThirtyLinesUltraSeeder: dataset 12 bulan untuk 30 lini — termasuk asuransi (polis + klaim), syariah (akad + bagi hasil), pendidikan (sekolah + enrollment), seafood/forest/textile (lot + trace), aviation (flight + seat), port (vessel call + yard), district (request + SLA) — miliaran baris, chunked, checkpoint/resume, deterministik

191:191.2.text: Benchmark per domain: ingest telematik, billing batch, settlement, learning progress, insurance claims, port yard op → waktu & puncak memori tercatat

191:191.3.text: Skalability forecast: proyeksi 3× volume → rekomendasi partisi/indeks sebelum diperlukan (dokumentasi EXPLAIN)

191:191.4.text: Tests: seeder idempoten dua kali, data relasi utuh (FK), ledger seluruh aset = 0 selisih setelah seeder, benchmark tercatat di AUDIT

192:192.1.text: Partisi time-based untuk tabel transaksional terbesar (telematik, meteran, order, booking, klaim, tiket) → strategi attach/detach per bulan

192:192.2.text: Cold archive & recall (memperluas Fase 55.8): data > 5 tahun → archive store dengan checksum → query berseleksi tetap bisa tarik → tidak membebani indeks aktif

192:192.3.text: Materialized summary per domain (rollup harian/bulanan) → dashboard memakai rollup → drill-down hanya saat diminta

192:192.4.text: Query budget registry: setiap endpoint kritis punya anggaran query & latensi p95 → dijalankan pada CI → regresi = gate merah

192:192.5.text: Tests: attach/detach tak menghilang data, archive recall checksum valid, rollup = agregasi mentah, budget CI terpasang & gagal saat melanggar

193:193.1.text: Peta kontensi: akun ledger, seat/tiket/kamar, stok OMS, kapasitas armada, kuota kelas → lock order policy global (urutan ID selalu konsisten) → anti-deadlock

193:193.2.text: Optimistic concurrency untuk record non-uang (draft kontrak, jadwal) → version conflict → retry dengan pesan jelas

193:193.3.text: Admission control: rate shed pada beban ekstrem (mis. flash sale, festival) → antrian adil (FIFO + member tier opsional) → tanpa kehilangan permintaan sah

193:193.4.text: Stress suite: 5.000 konkurensi terhadap titik panas → tepat teralokasi, tak negatif, tak ganda, latensi p95 tercatat

193:193.5.text: Tests: deadlock tak pernah terjadi pada 100 iterasi, optimistic conflict retry sukses, shed menolak dengan 429 + retry-after, stress suite hijau

194:194.1.text: Indeks pencarian global (produk, dokumen, pelanggan berizin, resi, kamar, program, kelas, aset, kontrak) → parsial, scope-aware (hanya hasil yang boleh dilihat pengguna)

194:194.2.text: Search-as-you-type & global command palette diperluas (Ctrl+K Fase 16.6) → lintas 30 lini, peran menentukan hasil

194:194.3.text: Full-text dokumen (kontrak, PO, invoice, sertifikat) dengan highlight → link ke sumber asli → akses policy dokumen ditegakkan saat preview

194:194.4.text: Tests: hasil tak pernah menembus scope (uji IDOR massal pada search), indeks sinkron ≤ SLA, highlight tak mengekspos PII yang disensor, relevansi deterministik

195:195.1.text: Model registry pusat: setiap model/aturan punya versi, pemilik, data latih snapshot hash, metrik evaluasi, approval rilis, rollback pointer

195:195.2.text: Evaluation harness: benchmark internal per domain (forecast MAPE, klaim fraud AUC simulasi, match quality) → gate rilis: skor tak boleh turun > ambang

195:195.3.text: Guardrails input/output: validasi schema, penolakan prompt injection pada konten user-generated (media/forum), redaksi PII sebelum inferensi eksternal

195:195.4.text: Model drift monitoring: distribusi input berubah → alert → retrain proposal → approval → rilis ber-versi → keputusan lama tetap ter-rekonstruksi dengan versi lama

195:195.5.text: Tests: rilis tanpa evaluasi ditolak, rollback memulihkan keputusan versi lama persis, drift alert terpicu pada data sintetis, PII tak terkirim ke sink eksternal

195:195.6.text: Edge case: rilis model gagal evaluasi → diblokir CI, bukan rilis dengan "deviasi kecil" tanpa approval

195:195.7.text: Data train berubah karena kebijakan privasi → model retrain wajib, versi lama diarsipkan

196:196.1.text: Agent runtime: setiap agen (bid Fase 84, claim Fase 72, ops Fase 143, concierge Fase 113.5) memakai kerangka sama — tool whitelist per peran, budget langkah, audit tiap aksi

196:196.2.text: Human-in-the-loop queues: aksi berisiko (uang besar, medis, kontrak, pemilihan talent) → antrean review per role → approve/reject/edit dengan alasan → masuk audit trail

196:196.3.text: Multi-agent collaboration: orkestrator menggabungkan agen (procurement + logistics + finance) untuk satu tujuan → rencana disetujui manusia sebelum eksekusi → hasil dilaporkan

196:196.4.text: Kill-switch & incident AI: matikan satu agen/semua agen dalam 1 detik → pending action dibatalkan bersih (tanpa potong uang setengah jalan) → postmortem

196:196.5.text: Tests: aksi di luar whitelist ditolak, budget langkah dihormati, kill-switch bersih pada 100 percobaan, alasan review tersimpan penuh

196:196.6.text: Edge case: agen stuck menunggu review → timeout + eskalasi, tak memblokir antrian review lain

196:196.7.text: Audit sampling agen level rendah: 5% aksi ditinjau manusia → temuan memicu pengetatan whitelist

197:197.1.text: Decision log: setiap keputusan otomatis menyimpan input snapshot, versi model, output, dan tindakan yang diambil → bisa di-replay identik (audit Fase 64.4 diperluas ke 30 lini)

197:197.2.text: Explainability view: alasan faktor utama (feature contribution simulasi) per keputusan penting → tersedia untuk reviewer & regulator simulasi

197:197.3.text: Fairness & bias check: hasil tidak boleh berbeda berdasarkan atribut terlindungi (uji statistik) → temuan → koreksi → tercatat

197:197.4.text: `ai:audit` final: coverage (keputusan tercatat / keputusan dibuat = 100%), rekonstruksi identik, drift policy dipatuhi → masuk health-check

197:197.5.text: Tests: replay identik 100% pada sampel, bias test punya threshold & fail saat melanggar, decision log append-only

197:197.6.text: Edge case: log keputusan tak bisa direplay (data dihapus) → tanda "unreproducible" → audit gagal → kontrol diperkuat

197:197.7.text: Bias remediation: temuan bias → perbaikan model → re-test fairness sebelum rilis ulang

198:198.1.text: Knowledge assistant internal: menjawab dari dokumen terverifikasi saja (ARCHITECTURE, RUNBOOK, kontrak, kebijakan) → sitasi wajib ke sumber → tanpa sitasi = tidak ditampilkan

198:198.2.text: SOP copilot: dari prosedur tertulis → checklist eksekusi terpandu → bukti langkah (foto, scan, tanda tangan) → audit kepatuhan SOP

198:198.3.text: Content generation terkontrol: draf kontrak dari template (Fase 28.2), laporan insiden, ringkasan meeting → selalu draft, approval manusia, hash dokumen saat disimpan

198:198.4.text: Hallucination guard: jawaban angka wajib berasal dari query sistem (bukan model) → angka tanpa sumber query = reject

198:198.5.text: Tests: jawaban tanpa sitasi ditolak, angka tak dari query ditolak, SOP checklist lengkap sebelum close, draf tak bisa terbit tanpa approval

198:198.6.text: Edge case: dokumen sumber diubah setelah jawaban dibuat → jawaban ditandai stale & di-refresh

198:198.7.text: Sumber tak ada → assistant jawab "tidak ada di korpus", tidak mengarang (grounding strict)

199:199.1.text: Optimizer terpusat: objective + constraints dideklarasikan per masalah (rute armada, jadwal shift, alokasi seat/kamar/kursi, kapasitas pabrik, portofolio investasi) → solver deterministik (greedy + local search ber-seed)

199:199.2.text: Constraint library: regulasi (jam kerja, kapasitas legal), kontrak (SLA, allotment), preferensi (service level) → solver wajib memuaskan hard constraint

199:199.3.text: Explainable recommendations: solusi + alasan (mengapa unit X di rute Y) + alternatif top-3 + dampak biaya/layanan → manusia pilih atau setujui

199:199.4.text: A/B dan shadow evaluation: jalankan optimizer di shadow mode → bandingkan dengan keputusan manual → metrik kualitas → go-live bertahap per domain

199:199.5.text: Tests: hard constraint tak pernah dilanggar (uji 1000 skenario), deterministik dua run, shadow metrics tercatat, rollback ke manual mudah

199:199.6.text: Edge case: tak ada solusi feasible → laporkan infeasibility + constraint paling longgar yang dilanggar, bukan solusi melanggar aturan

199:199.7.text: Optimizer versi & seed tercatat → keputusan bisa direkonstruksi

200:200.1.text: Signal mesh: gabung sinyal lintas lini (pembayaran mencurigakan, klaim beruntun, resale tiket, selisih timbangan, meteran dimanipulasi, retur berulang, komisi aneh) → skor gabungan per entitas

200:200.2.text: Case management: alert → case → bukti (link ke voucher/telematik/dokumen) → investigasi → keputusan (freeze/block/chargeback/flag regulator simulasi) → appeal

200:200.3.text: AML workflow: KYC refresh, PEP/sanctions screening periodik, transaction monitoring rulebook, SAR filing simulasi gapless

200:200.4.text: Feedback loop: case closed → label → evaluasi model (precision pada sampel) → guardrail false-positive rate (tidak boleh menahan transaksi sah > ambang)

200:200.5.text: Tests: true positive terdeteksi pada seed, false positive rate ≤ ambang, freeze membutuhkan approval, SAR numbering gapless, `fraud:audit` clean

200:200.6.text: Edge case: false positive massal saat rule baru → circuit breaker rule → rollback rule, review tuning

200:200.7.text: Due process: terduga fraud diberi hak pembelaan internal → keputusan freeze tidak final tanpa review

201:201.1.text: Registry forecast per domain (demand resto, room, tiket, listrik, bahan baku, talent, klaim) → model per domain dengan backtest → MAPE tercatat per model

201:201.2.text: Hierarki forecast: agregat nasional → region → entitas → SKU/unit → reconciliasi bottom-up/top-down (forecast konsisten di semua level)

201:201.3.text: Executive S&OP lintas lini: demand review → supply & capacity → financial balancing → sign-off (Fase 53.3 diperluas ke 30 lini termasuk tenaga kerja, energi, kamar, seat)

201:201.4.text: Scenario forecasting: baseline / konservatif / agresif + shock (wabah, krisis komoditas, blackout) → dampak P&L & kas per lini dalam sandbox

201:201.5.text: Tests: rekonsiliasi hierarki tepat, backtest deterministik, scenario tak mengubah data riil, sign-off butuh approval, `tower:audit` clean

201:201.6.text: Edge case: data historis tak cukup untuk model → fallback ke metode sederhana + confidence label rendah, bukan angka palsu

201:201.7.text: Risiko: forecast terlalu akurat dihargai berlebihan → override manual selalu dicatat dengan alasan (Fase 53.2)

202:202.1.text: Risk taxonomy 30 lini (strategis, operasional, keuangan, kepatuhan, teknologi, reputasi, lingkungan, sumber daya) → register risiko dengan pemilik, inherent score, control set, residual score

202:202.2.text: Risk assessment cycle: identifikasi → analisis (likelihood × impact finansial simulasi) → treatment (avoid/mitigate/transfer/accept) → monitoring → review berkala

202:202.3.text: Key risk indicators (KRI) otomatis dari sistem (ratio konsentrasi, downtime, NPF, denial klaim, siklus kas, insiden safety) → breach → eskalasi pemilik risiko

202:202.4.text: Risk appetite statement per lini → keputusan besar (capex, ekspansi, kontrak) dicek terhadap appetite → melanggar = approval dewan wajib

202:202.5.text: Tests: KRI terhitung dari data nyata, appetite breach memblokir/escalate, review cycle terjadwal, `risk:audit` clean

202:202.6.text: Taxonomy versioned: risk owner bisa mengusulkan kategori baru → review komite → migrasi register lama

202:202.7.text: Scenario linkage: risiko material diuji lewat stress scenario Fase 243 → hasil memperbarui residual score

203:203.1.text: Pemetaan kontrol per proses kritikal 30 lini (preventive/detective) → kontrol otomatis (system-enforced) vs manual (dengan bukti) → control matrix

203:203.2.text: SoD matrix diperluas ke seluruh lini (Fase 54.4): konflik role per domain → deteksi pengguna punya konflik → remediation (reassign/compensating control)

203:203.3.text: Automated control testing harian: contoh 3-way match, approval limit, capacity cap, pin/OTP enforcement → pass/fail → fail → issue → CAPA

203:203.4.text: Segregation of privileged access: admin sistem tak boleh menyetujui transaksi uang → break-glass procedure tercatat & diaudit berkala

203:203.5.text: Tests: SoD conflict terdeteksi pada seed, control test gagal membuat issue, break-glass memicu audit, `enterprise:audit` clean

203:203.6.text: Compensating control: jika konflik SoD tak bisa dihindari (tim kecil) → pengawasan tambahan + review independen

203:203.7.text: Control evidence retention: bukti kontrol tersimpan sesuai jadwal, searchable auditor

204:204.1.text: Asset & threat inventory: sistem, dependency, data kelas risiko → attack surface map → prioritas hardening

204:204.2.text: Vulnerability management: scan simulasi → temuan → severity SLA perbaikan → verifikasi close → aging report

204:204.3.text: Incident response playbook (memperluas Fase 144.4): deteksi → containment (isolate modul/token) → eradication → recovery → postmortem → regulatory notification simulasi

204:204.4.text: Resilience testing: backup integrity, failover, ransomware recovery drill (rekonstruksi ledger dari backup + replay → Σ=0), tabletop exercise terjadwal

204:204.5.text: Tests: containment memutus akses dalam ambang waktu, restore drill lolos tanpa data loss, vulnerability SLA terukur, `dr:audit` + health-check clean

204:204.6.text: Asset inventory update: service/dependency baru otomatis menambah attack surface map

204:204.7.text: Tabletop ransomware tiap lini kritikal → lessons masuk control backlog

205:205.1.text: Vendor criticality tiering (50.000 pihak ketiga: pemasok, carrier, cloud, broker, outsourcer) → due diligence depth per tier → monitoring periodik

205:205.2.text: Fourth-party risk: dependency pemasok atas sub-vendor → konsentrasi terdeteksi (mis. semua butuh 1 penyedia logistik) → rekomendasi diversifikasi

205:205.3.text: Concentration dashboard: exposure gabungan per pihak (Fase 27.7) lintas lini → batas wajar → melanggar → approval sebelum transaksi baru

205:205.4.text: Exit & continuity per vendor: kontrak exit clause, data return, re-kualifikasi pemasok pengganti playbook → diuji berkala

205:205.5.text: Tests: concentration breach terdeteksi, tier menentukan kedalaman due diligence, exit playbook lengkap, `vendor:audit` clean

205:205.6.text: Edge case: vendor gagal mendadak (bangkrut/terkena sanksi) → continuity playbook dieksekusi dalam SLA, transaksi terblokir sementara

205:205.7.text: Risiko: konsentrasi geografis (semua vendor di satu region) → peta risiko region + alternatif kualifikasi

206:206.1.text: Business impact analysis per lini per negara: proses kritikal → RTO/RPO tier → dependency map (yang harus jalan agar yang lain jalan)

206:206.2.text: Continuity plans: workarounds, alternate suppliers, alternate site, workforce redeployment (gig bridge Fase 85) → terhubung playbook per modul

206:206.3.text: Crisis command center: incident kelas krisis → war room virtual (peran: komunikasi, operasi, legal, keuangan) → timeline keputusan tercatat → media statement (approval)

206:206.4.text: Annual full-scale drill: simulasi multi-lini (mis. blackout + banjir wilayah) → jalankan continuity → recovery → audit bersih → lessons → plan update

206:206.5.text: Tests: drill menghasilkan RTO terukur per tier, continuity tak melanggar control (mis. bayar manual tetap approval), playbook update tercatat

206:206.6.text: Edge case: krisis menyentuh banyak lini sekaligus → prioritas service (RS/pembayaran/keselamatan) menang, lainnya degraded

206:206.7.text: Komunikasi krisis: holding statement template per skenario, approval chain, satu sumber kebenaran publik

207:207.1.text: Regulatory change feed (simulasi per yurisdiksi) → impact analysis per modul (apa yang berubah: tarif, batas, pelaporan) → tugas perubahan ke tim terkait

207:207.2.text: Policy & procedure lifecycle: draft → review hukum → approval → publish → training (Edu Fase 135) → acknowledgment karyawan → attestation → review periodik

207:207.3.text: Rule-to-code translation: regulasi yang bisa diotomasi → jadi guardrail sistem (mis. batas suku bunga, jam kerja, kapasitas) → uji kepatuhan otomatis

207:207.4.text: Examination readiness: paket bukti per regulator (Fase 54.7 diperluas per sektor) → ekspor terstruktur → mock audit internal

207:207.5.text: Tests: regulatory change menciptakan tugas, guardrail baru aktif & teruji, acknowledgment wajib sebelum shift role kritis, `compliance:audit` clean

207:207.6.text: Edge case: regulasi berubah retroaktif → kalkulasi ulang periode terdampak dengan approval, jejak audit jelas

207:207.7.text: Policy conflict: kebijakan baru bertentangan lama → resolusi eksplisit sebelum publish, bukan dua kebijakan hidup

208:208.1.text: Consolidated indirect tax engine 30 lini: PPN per yurisdiksi, e-faktur simulasi, withholding (PPh 21/23/26/4(2)), transfer pricing documentation (Fase 52.2) lintas entitas baru

208:208.2.text: Customs compliance lanjut: classification QA (HS code review), valuation support, origin management, drawback/restitution, free trade zone (simulasi)

208:208.3.text: Tax provision & effective rate: laba kena pajak per entitas → beban pajak → rekonsiliasi buku vs fiskal (temporary/permanent difference) → pelaporan

208:208.4.text: Trade-based money laundering guard: invoice mismatch detection, round-trip trade flag → hold & review (bridge ke Fase 200)

208:208.5.text: Tests: Σ pajak = perhitungan aturan per yurisdiksi, reconciliation buku-fiskal konsisten, gapless numbering, `enterprise:audit` + `trade:audit` clean

208:208.6.text: Edge case: aturan pajak berubah di tengah periode → split period kalkulasi, effective dating aturan

208:208.7.text: Position paper: setiap posisi pajak material punya justifikasi hukum + approval sebelum pelaporan

209:209.1.text: Continuous close: subledger reconciliation otomatis harian (bukan bulanan) → variance alert → adjust sebelum periode berakhir → lock period ketat (Fase 54.2)

209:209.2.text: Journal automation: recurring, accrual, allocation, revaluation → template ber-versi → auto-post dengan parameter tercatat → review sampel berkala

209:209.3.text: Intercompany maturation: matching otomatis invoice vs bill antar entitas → mismatch report → resolusi dalam SLA → eliminasi lebih bersih (Fase 52.4)

209:209.4.text: Statutory reporting pack per negara: neraca, laba rugi, arus kas, catatan → format regulator simulasi → gapless & sign-off

209:209.5.text: Tests: close checklist lengkap sebelum lock, accrual reverse tepat periode, IC matching ≥ target, statutory pack konsisten dengan ledger, `enterprise:audit` clean

209:209.6.text: Edge case: close gagal di tengah (entitas belum siap) → period tetap terbuka dengan status terlihat, tak di-lock paksa

209:209.7.text: Materiality threshold: variance kecil di-bypass dengan alasan tercatat, bukan disembunyikan

210:210.1.text: Capital structure model: debt/equity per entitas, covenant ratio (Fase 48.7) lintas 30 lini → headroom → early warning → opsi (refinancing, equity via RWA/sukuk Fase 162, dividen policy)

210:210.2.text: Funding pipeline: kebutuhan proyek (EPC, ekspansi) → sumber (kas, bank, sukuk, investor syndication Fase 118.3, ILS Fase 157.5) → biaya & tenor → keputusan Treasury

210:210.3.text: Dividend & distribution policy: per entitas (suku bagi hasil syariah, dividen token, payout RWA) → test profit & solvabilitas → approval → jurnal → withholding

210:210.4.text: Credit rating simulation: faktor (leverage, coverage, diversifikasi, governance) → skor → hubungan ke biaya dana (interest spread) → aksi perbaikan terukur

210:210.5.text: Tests: covenant breach terdeteksi sebelum jatuh tempo, distribusi tak melebihi profit tersedia, funding cost = actual terbayar, `treasury:audit` clean

210:210.6.text: Edge case: covenant terancam breach → aksi cepat (jual aset/refinance/penyertaan) via approval darurat, bukan menunggu laporan

210:210.7.text: Kapasitas utang agregat: exposure gabungan seluruh entitas vs total ekuitas → guardrail grup

211:211.1.text: Earnings cycle: guidance (internal), actual vs guidance variance root-cause, press release draf (approval), investor FAQ knowledge base (Fase 198.1)

211:211.2.text: KPI & non-GAAP reconciliation: setiap metrik non-standar punya bridge ke standar → konsistensi definisi (Fase 189.2) → auditor simulasi puas

211:211.3.text: Market data & valuation: harga token/sukuk/RWA (orderbook Fase 71/162) → fair value assessment periodik → disclosure jika deviasi signifikan

211:211.4.text: Shareholder register & corporate actions: dilusi, stock split simulasi token, right issue, voting record date → terintegrasi DAO (Fase 86)

211:211.5.text: Tests: guidance cycle terdokumentasi, non-GAAP bridge konsisten, corporate action Σ token tetap seimbang, `group:audit` clean

211:211.6.text: Edge case: market data tak tersedia (private asset) → fair value pakai valuation model dengan range ketidakpastian

211:211.7.text: Disclosure event material → approval legal + board → publikasi serentak ke semua pemegang saham

212:212.1.text: Profitability hierarchy: entitas → lini → unit → produk/kanal/proyek → pelanggan/kontrak → channel profitability sejati (biaya layanan, fulfillment, akuisisi ter-allocate)

212:212.2.text: Full costing 30 lini: ABC (activity-based) untuk overhead kompleks → driver per aktivitas → biaya benar per objek → keputusan price/make/buy

212:212.3.text: Transfer pricing optimization (dalam batas arm's length Fase 52.2): simulasi struktur → dampak pajak & motivasi manajer → implementation via intercompany contract

212:212.4.text: Margin bridge & drill-to-voucher: laba periode ini vs lalu → volume/mix/price/cost/FX → setiap komponen terjelaskan hingga voucher sumber

212:212.5.text: Tests: profitability Σ unit = entitas = konsolidasi, driver allocation deterministik, TP method konsisten dokumentasi, margin bridge balance, `group:audit` clean

212:212.6.text: Edge case: biaya shared services dialokasikan tanpa driver tepat → akun unallocated transparan + metodologi diperbaiki

212:212.7.text: Transfer pricing adjustment akhir tahun → jurnal true-up idempoten & dokumentasi alasan

213:213.1.text: QMS framework lintas lini: standar mutu per domain (medis JCI simulasi, food HACCP, manufacturing ISO 9001 simulasi, hotel star standard Fase 111.1, port ISPS) → policy terpusat, eksekusi per lini

213:213.2.text: Nonconformance & CAPA unified: temuan → root cause (5-Why/fishbone terstruktur) → tindakan → verifikasi efektivitas → jadwal audit lanjutan

213:213.3.text: Audit program: audit internal terjadwal (internalisasi, eksternal, pihak ketiga) → temuan → rating kesiapan → gate sertifikasi

213:213.4.text: Customer/partner complaint unified: intake multi-kanal → klasifikasi → investigasi → root cause → kredit/klaim jika perlu → closure satisfaction

213:213.5.text: Tests: CAPA overdue tereskalasi, audit finding punya action plan, complaint terhubung ledger jika ada kompensasi, `quality:audit` clean

213:213.6.text: Edge case: temuan audit lintas domain → pemilik bersama + CAPA tunggal dengan sub-tindakan per lini

213:213.7.text: Sertifikasi lini (ISO/JCI simulasi) → evidence pack otomatis dari QMS → gate kelulusan

214:214.1.text: Unified asset reliability: mesin pabrik, alat berat, armada, alat medis, gedung, kapal, pesawat, transformer → strategy per kelas (corrective/preventive/predictive) → work order terpusat

214:214.2.text: Condition monitoring: sensor (vibration, thermography, oil, ultrasound simulasi) → health index → prediction → part ordering terhubung MRP (Fase 82.1)

214:214.3.text: Reliability metrics: MTBF, MTTR, availability, PM compliance, backlog aging, wrench time → target per kelas aset → improvement project

214:214.4.text: Spare parts strategy: criticality × lead time → stocking level, consignment dengan vendor, emergency sourcing → biaya inventory vs downtime ter-optimal

214:214.5.text: Tests: prediction trigger WO sekali, part availability gate repair, metrics = agregasi nyata, TCO konsisten (Fase 31.7), `ast:audit` clean

214:214.6.text: Edge case: prediksi kegagalan keliru (false positive) → WO dibatalkan dengan alasan, model dikoreksi

214:214.7.text: Critical spare single-source → dual-source qualification atau buffer stok sesuai criticality matrix

215:215.1.text: Network design: lokasi DC/gudang/kitchen/dark store/port → service coverage vs cost → simulator optimasi lokasi (Fase 199.1) → rekomendasi capex

215:215.2.text: Multi-echelon execution: allocation & deployment otomatis (stok pusat → regional → forward) berdasar forecast (Fase 201) & safety stock (Fase 53.5) → in-transit visibility

215:215.3.text: Yard & dock scheduling 30 lokasi: appointment window, equipment & labor availability → no-show policy → throughput KPI (memperluas Fase 24.5)

215:215.4.text: Freight procurement: tender pengangkutan berkala (Fase 33.3) → lane pricing → mode split (road/rail/sea/air simulasi) → cost-to-serve per order

215:215.5.text: Tests: allocation tak melebihi supply, appointment conflict ditolak, tender evaluation reproducible, cost-to-serve = biaya nyata, `wms:audit` + `lgx:audit-billing` clean

215:215.6.text: Edge case: jaringan berubah (site baru/tutup) → model desain dijalankan ulang → rekomendasi capex disetujui

215:215.7.text: In-transit inventory: stok dalam perjalanan tetap terlihat & insured → hilang = klaim (Fase 23.4)

216:216.1.text: Field service unification: teknisi (AutoServe, facility, media crew, medical equipment, network, mining maintenance) → skill & sertifikasi → scheduling → dispatch → mobile app → POD

216:216.2.text: SLA engine terpusat: definisi SLA per kontrak/lini (response, resolution, uptime) → timer → breach detection → credit/penalty otomatis (Fase 47.7, 29.2) → laporan ke mitra

216:216.3.text: Parts van inventory & tooling: stok di kendaraan teknisi → reserve/consume → restock route → rekonsiliasi

216:216.4.text: First-time fix optimization: diagnosis knowledge base (Fase 198.2) → check list benar → bring right part → FTF rate naik → biaya turun

216:216.5.text: Tests: technician tanpa sertifikasi valid ditolak tugas kritikal, SLA timer deterministik, credit post tepat saat breach, van inventory = konsumsi, `field:audit` clean

216:216.6.text: Edge case: teknisi tak punya suku cadang saat tugas → fallback ke gudang terdekat + revisi jadwal, SLA timer jalan

216:216.7.text: Subkontrak field service → kontrak jasa + SLA + skor vendor (Fase 47.7 bridge)

217:217.1.text: PPM platform: proyek (konstruksi, event, media, implementasi sistem, kampanye) → WBS → resource → cost → schedule → risk → change → close

217:217.2.text: Gantt & critical path (deterministik) → dependency violation detection → leveling resource lintas lini (talent sharing Fase 97.1)

217:217.3.text: Portfolio view: kumpulan proyek → skor strategis + IRR + kapasitas → prioritas → kapitalisasi realokasi (memperluas Fase 141.2) → benefit realization terukur setelah go-live

217:217.4.text: Change request & ECO bridge: perubahan ruang lingkup → dampak biaya/jadwal → approval → kontrak/PO/amandemen terhubung (Fase 29.4)

217:217.5.text: Tests: dependency cycle ditolak, resource overallocation terdeteksi, change tak dieksekusi tanpa approval, benefit tracking tercatat, `ppm:audit` clean

217:217.6.text: Edge case: proyek over budget → escalation approval sebelum lanjut; tak ada biaya terpendam diam-diam

217:217.7.text: Close-out proyek: benefit review, lessons, resource dilepas, kontrak ditutup, dokumen diarsip

218:218.1.text: R&D portfolio (memperluas Fase 59): ide → hipotesis → eksperimen → hasil → stage gate → lab-to-plant transfer → benefit tracking → kill/scale decision

218:218.2.text: IP portfolio management: paten, merek, rahasia dagang, lisensi masuk/keluar → biaya, tenggat, territorial coverage → freedom-to-operate check sebelum launch

218:218.3.text: Tech transfer playbook: prototipe → proses terdokumentasi → pilot line → quality validation → mass production release → knowledge capture ke SOP copilot

218:218.4.text: Researcher mobility & collaboration: riset lintas lini/entitas/negara → cost sharing (Fase 52.1) → data & IP sharing agreement → kredit publikasi (media simulasi)

218:218.5.text: Tests: stage gate tak bisa dilewati, IP deadline tak terlewat (alert), transfer butuh quality sign-off, cost sharing Σ = biaya riil, `plm:audit` clean

218:218.6.text: Edge case: riset gagal → kill decision terdokumentasi, data & IP diarsipkan untuk pembelajaran

218:218.7.text: Publication/paten overlap: deteksi duplikasi riset antar unit → kolaborasi, bukan duplikasi biaya

219:219.1.text: Customer master & golden record: pencocokan (NIK/NPWP/email/telepon ter-encrypt) → merge reversible (Fase 27.5) → profil 360 (transaksi lintas lini dengan consent)

219:219.2.text: B2C & B2B account hierarchy: individu, keluarga, perusahaan, tenant, member → contact roles → credit & contract terkait → pic lintas lini

219:219.3.text: Interaction timeline: semua sentuhan (layanan, tiket, pembelian, keluhan, campaign) → satu riwayat → agen mana pun melihat lengkap (sesuai scope)

219:219.4.text: Consent & preference center: izin marketing, share data antar lini, kanal komunikasi → dicatat → dihormati lintas modul (Fase 144.2 bridge)

219:219.5.text: Tests: merge konsisten, consent menutup akses, timeline lengkap tanpa bocor scope, duplicate detection deterministic, `crm:audit` clean

219:219.6.text: Edge case: merge salah (dua orang berbeda) → undo procedure → data pemilik asli pulih tanpa kehilangan transaksi

219:219.7.text: Data residency profil pelanggan: penyimpanan sesuai yurisdiksi (Fase 582) untuk pelanggan lintas negara

220:220.1.text: Unified service desk: tiket multi-kanal (app, telepon simulasi, chat, email, walk-in) → routing skill-based → SLA → escalation → CSAT → root cause analytics

220:220.2.text: Case management lintas lini: satu kasus bisa menyentuh RS+hotel+logistik (mis. klaim perjalanan) → sub-case per lini → orkestrasi → solusi terpadu

220:220.3.text: Loyalty unification final (memperluas Fase 112): satu mata uang poin untuk 30 lini → earning/redeem rules registry → liability terkendali → anti-fraud → breakage policy konsisten

220:220.4.text: Tier & benefits engine: benefit multi-lini (upgrade, fast track, diskon, akses) → entitlement check terpusat → fulfillment tercatat → cost benefit = ledger

220:220.5.text: Tests: kasus lintas lini ter-orchestrate tanpa double refund, poin Σ seimbang, entitlement tak bisa di-abuse, CSAT terkumpul, `crm:audit` + loyalty reconcile clean

220:220.6.text: Edge case: kasus lintas lini gagal di satu sub-case → orchestrator tak menutup kasus induk sampai semua sub-case selesai

220:220.7.text: Poin economy abuse: velocity & pattern score → freeze poin sementara → investigasi (bridge Fase 200)

221:221.1.text: Subscription engine lintas lini: membership hotel, ISP, edukasi, cloud, asuransi berkala, langganan konten → plan/version/price grandfather/trial/pause/cancel/reactivate

221:221.2.text: Billing lifecycle: invoice → dunning (reminder bertahap) → grace → suspend (layanan berhenti otomatis) → retry → collect → write-off approval → reactivation

221:221.3.text: Retention intelligence: churn risk score (pola usage, komplain, telat bayar) → playbook retensi (tawaran, diskon berizin, escalation human) → churn prevented terukur → biaya retensi vs LTV

221:221.4.text: Win-back: pelanggan berhenti → campaign reaktivasi → penawaran spesifik → konversi → cohort analysis

221:221.5.text: Tests: suspend otomatis menghentikan layanan (bukan tagih gratis), dunning schedule deterministik, retention offer tak melanggar margin guard, churn cohort akurat, `billing:audit` clean

221:221.6.text: Edge case: dunning gagal semua kanal → escalation ke collection, bukan infinite retry diam-diam

221:221.7.text: Pause vs cancel: pause mempertahankan benefit terbatas; cancel menghapus → aturan jelas & diuji

222:222.1.text: Segment engine: RFM, behavior, lifecycle, value tier → segment dinamis (update real-time) → membership campaign ke segmen

222:222.2.text: Campaign orchestration: journey builder (multi-step, kondisi, split) → eksekusi kanal (push, in-app, email simulasi) → frequency cap → opt-out dihormati

222:222.3.text: Promotion governance: budget per kampanye (encumbrance Fase 54.1) → approval melewati budget → redemption control → effective cost = ledger

222:222.4.text: Attribution model: first/last/multi-touch (deterministik) → kontribusi kanal ke konversi → ROI per kampanye → feed ke budget allocation (Fase 141.2)

222:222.5.text: Tests: segment konsisten, frequency cap dihormati, promo budget tak terlampaui tanpa approval, attribution Σ konversi = 100%, `marketing:audit` clean

222:222.6.text: Edge case: frequency cap lintas channel → cap global per subjek, bukan per channel (menghindari spam)

222:222.7.text: Fatigue & suppression: subjek komplain → campaign berhenti → case service desk terkait

223:223.1.text: Org design: struktur 30 lini lintas negara (Fase 58.1) → position management (jabatan, grade, reporting line, budget headcount) → perubahan org via approval → impact simulation

223:223.2.text: Workforce planning: demand per fungsi (dari S&OP & proyek Fase 201/217) → supply internal (skill, capacity, attrition forecast) → gap → build/buy/borrow/gig (Fase 85/136)

223:223.3.text: Succession & bench: posisi kritikal → kandidat pengganti → readiness → development plan (Edu Fase 135) → risiko single-point-of-failure SDM terdeteksi

223:223.4.text: Headcount governance: requisition → org fit → budget check → approval chain → offer → onboarding → cost tercatat dari hari pertama

223:223.5.text: Tests: headcount over budget ditolak, succession coverage terukur, org change tak memutus reporting structure aktif, `hcm:audit` clean

223:223.6.text: Edge case: hiring freeze mendadak → requisition tertahan dengan alasan, pipeline tak hilang

223:223.7.text: Org change berdampak ke sistem (role/scope) → integrasi ke RBAC & access provisioning (Fase 225.3)

224:224.1.text: Job architecture: job family, level, grade band (market data simulasi) → pay structure lintas negara (Fase 152.1) → compression/equity check

224:224.2.text: Variable pay: bonus kinerja (per entitas/lini/individu, scorecard) → payout saat capai → clawback saat restatement → komisi sales/agensi (bridge Fase 45)

224:224.3.text: Benefits administration: asuransi kesehatan/jiwa (Fase 159), pensiun, wellness (Fase 159.3), flexible benefit → enrollment → cost payroll & intercompany

224:224.4.text: Pay equity audit berkala: statistik gap terkoreksi faktor sah → temuan → remediasi plan → laporan ke governance (Fase 141.4)

224:224.5.text: Tests: pay band dihormati, bonus Σ = pool, benefit enrollment valid saat kejadian, pay equity method tercatat, `hcm:audit` clean

224:224.6.text: Edge case: karyawan pindah negara → pay structure & benefit berubah efektif tanggal, historis tak diubah

224:224.7.text: Retroactive pay correction → approval + jurnal adjustment tercatat, bukan edit slip lama

225:225.1.text: Recruitment pipeline: requisition → sourcing (talent pool Fase 136.1) → screening otomatis (skill match, Fase 199) → interview → offer → background check → accept

225:225.2.text: Candidate experience & compliance: consent data pelamar → retensi data → anonymized reporting → anti-bias check pada screening (Fase 197.3)

225:225.3.text: Onboarding: pre-day tasks → day-1 access provisioning (scoped, Fase 188) → training path (Fase 167.4) → probation review → confirm

225:225.4.text: Offboarding: resignation → knowledge transfer checklist → asset return (Fase 30) → account deprovision dalam ambang waktu → final settlement (leave, bonus pro-rata) → alumni pool opsional

225:225.5.text: Tests: access hilang tepat waktu setelah offboarding, asset return gate final pay, onboarding gate sebelum shift mandiri, candidate data tak bocor, `hcm:audit` clean

225:225.6.text: Edge case: kandidat gagal background check → keputusan terdokumentasi, data di-retention sesuai kebijakan

225:225.7.text: Rehire policy: alumni/blacklist → aturan eligibilitas terdokumentasi, tak discretionary diam-diam

226:226.1.text: Performance cycle: goal (OKR/KPI terhubung business plan) → check-in berkala → review (self/peer/manager) → calibration lintas divisi → rating → link ke bonus (Fase 224.2)

226:226.2.text: Engagement survey: pulse berkala → analisis driver → action plan per tim → follow-up effectiveness → attrition correlation

226:226.3.text: People analytics: turnover, regretted attrition, time-to-fill, productivity per FTE, overtime exposure, safety incident rate per populasi → prediksi risiko attrition → retention outreach

226:226.4.text: Manager effectiveness: score tim (engagement, growth, retention, delivery) → development program → promosi berbasis data + judgment terdokumentasi

226:226.5.text: Tests: calibration tak mengubah aturan tersembunyi, survey anonimitas (grup < n ditolak), predictive metric deterministik, `hcm:audit` clean

226:226.6.text: Edge case: calibration mengubah rating massal → butuh justifikasi & monitoring bias per tim

226:226.7.text: Survey anonymity: threshold kelompok kecil ditegakkan (Fase 584) agar responden aman

227:227.1.text: Learning cloud 30 lini: katalog gabungan (formal Fase 166, micro Fase 135, on-job, compliance) → rekomendasi per role & career path → learning hour tracking

227:227.2.text: Skill ontology & intelligence: skill graph (terhubung Fase 136.1) → gap analysis per unit → reskilling program → sertifikasi wajib (role kritikal) → dashboard kesiapan

227:227.3.text: Content factory: produksi konten internal (media studio Fase 133 + instruktur) → versioning → effectiveness (pre/post test, on-job metric) → retire konten usang

227:227.4.text: Education-business loop: permintaan skill dari operasi → kurikulum baru (Edu Fase 166.1) → lulusan terserap (Fase 136) → efektivitas terukur → investasi lanjutan

227:227.5.text: Tests: skill gap calculation konsisten, compliance learning gate role, content version immutable saat dipakai, effectiveness tercatat, `campus:audit` + `edu:audit` clean

227:227.6.text: Edge case: sertifikasi wajib kedaluwarsa saat tugas berjalan → handover aman + tugas baru tertahan

227:227.7.text: Content usang saat dipakai kelas → version lock per enrollment, upgrade hanya kelas baru

228:228.1.text: ESG data fabric: pengumpulan metrik E-S-G dari 30 lini (emisi Fase 60, air, limbah, energi, keragaman, safety Fase 120, governance) → quality score per metric → provenance

228:228.2.text: Double materiality assessment: impact materiality (dampak lini ke dunia) + financial materiality (dampak dunia ke lini) → material topic per lini → scope laporan

228:228.3.text: Reporting standards bridge (GRI/ISSB simulasi): mapping internal metric → disclosure requirement → evidence attachment → gap report

228:228.4.text: Assurance readiness: audit trail per angka ESG (dari sensor/ledger) → sampling export → mock assurance → findings → remediation

228:228.5.text: Tests: Σ metrik lini = agregasi grup, evidence terhubung sumber, gap tak tercatat sebagai comply, `esg:audit` clean

228:228.5#2.text: Edge case: metrik ESG gagal terkumpul (sensor mati) → jangan estimate diam-diam; tandai data gap + alert

228:228.6.text: Materiality change: topik naik/turun materialitas → review komite → scope laporan disesuaikan

228:228.7.text: Data quality score ESG per metrik → metrik skor rendah tak boleh dipakai untuk klaim publik

229:229.1.text: Net-zero roadmap per lini: baseline → target interim → levers (efisiensi, elektrifikasi, bahan hijau, offset) → capex & savings → tracking actual vs jalur

229:229.2.text: Energy transition portfolio: proyek solar/wind/biomass/storage (Fase 123/126) → IRR + carbon benefit → prioritization → funding (Fase 210.2)

229:229.3.text: Carbon price internal (shadow price): keputusan investasi dinilai dengan biaya karbon internal → proyek tinggi emisi butuh mitigasi → konsisten dengan roadmap

229:229.4.text: Climate risk physical & transition: risiko lokasi (banjir, panas, regulasi) per aset → adaptation plan → insurance alignment (Fase 157.4) → disclosure

229:229.5.text: Tests: roadmap tracking konsisten metrik, shadow price terpakai di appraisal, adaptation plan terhubung aset & polis, `esg:audit` clean

229:229.6.text: Edge case: offset dipakai sebelum reduksi prioritas → kebijakan tidak mengizinkan offset menggantikan abatement wajib

229:229.7.text: Scope 3 estimasi: faktor emisi versi tercatat; angka estimasi dilabeli, bukan diklaim terukur

230:230.1.text: Circularity targets 30 lini: recycled content, waste diversion, product take-back, packaging reuse → per lini → pipeline inisiatif → tracking mass balance (Fase 174)

230:230.2.text: Water stewardship: baseline per site → withdrawal/recycle/discharge → water-stressed area flag → reduction projects → quality compliance (Fase 124.2 scale)

230:230.3.text: Nature-positive portfolio: proyek restorasi (Fase 173) dikaitkan footprint operasi → target nature-positive per entitas → verification cycle

230:230.4.text: Green procurement policy: kriteria wajib dalam tender (Fase 33.3 + 60.4) → skor mempengaruhi award → supplier improvement program

230:230.5.text: Tests: circular metrics = mass balance nyata, water target terhitung dari meteran, green criteria terpakai di evaluation, `esg:audit` clean

230:230.6.text: Edge case: target air di lokasi water-stressed → prioritas proyek + capex disetujui lebih awal

230:230.7.text: Green premium diklaim hanya bila data produk terverifikasi (Fase 289) → anti-greenwashing

231:231.1.text: Board composition & committees (audit, risk, nomrem/gov, sustainability, comp) → charter → meeting cycle → agenda & paper (dokumen 26.8) → minutes → decision register

231:231.2.text: Delegation of authority matrix (DoA): per jenis keputusan (capex, kontrak, hiring, pricing, disclosure) → level (direksi, komite, CEO, unit) → batas nilai → enforcement di sistem (approval engine read matrix)

231:231.3.text: Conflict of interest register: deklarasi → screening transaksi terkait → abstain wajib → disclosure simulation

231:231.4.text: Decision traceability: setiap keputusan besar → paper, alternatif dinilai, dissent tercatat → archive → searchable oleh auditor (Fase 176.4)

231:231.5.text: Tests: approval di luar DoA ditolak, abstain mengubah quorum calculation, decision register append-only, `gov:audit` clean

231:231.6.text: Edge case: quorum tak tercapai → rapat ditunda dengan aturan quorum minoritas terdokumentasi

231:231.7.text: Direskan anggota berkonflik → pengganti sementara dari alternatif yang telah ditetapkan

232:232.1.text: Speak-up channel: laporan anonim (token pelapor opsional) → case terenkripsi → investigator assigned (four-eyes) → triage → investigation → outcome → feedback pelapor

232:232.2.text: Anti-retaliation policy & monitoring: proteksi pelapor → perubahan treatment terdeteksi → investigasi terpisah → sanksi

232:232.3.text: Ethics case management: code of conduct violation → hearing simulasi → sanction matrix konsisten → appeal → record terpisah dari HR data dengan akses ketat

232:232.4.text: Fraud referral bridge: temuan ethics → jika ada indikasi fraud → case di Fraud mesh (Fase 200) → koordinasi tanpa duplikasi penyelidikan

232:232.5.text: Tests: anonimitas pelapor terjaga (analisis metadata tidak membocorkan), case access terbatas, retaliation flag memicu investigasi, `ethics:audit` clean

232:232.6.text: Edge case: pelapor identitasnya bocor → investigasi tersendiri + sanksi; proses tak berhenti

232:232.7.text: Anti-SLAPP: gugatan terhadap pelapor → dukungan hukum simulasi + log kebenaran fakta

233:233.1.text: Governance model evolution (memperluas Fase 86): proposal classes (strategis, operasional, sosial, teknis) → kelas berbeda bobot pemilih & quorum → delegation (pemilih boleh wakilkan suara) → liquid democracy simulasi

233:233.2.text: Stakeholder assemblies: karyawan, mitra, franchisee, holder token, komunitas lokal (desa tambang Fase 124.3), pelanggan loyalty top tier → konsultasi non-binding vs voting binding dipisah jelas

233:233.3.text: On-chain-style voting ledger: vote hash-chained, tally diverifikasi publik (tanpa bocor identitas), hasil immutable → eksekusi otomatis via bridge (Fase 86.6) dengan safety review

233:233.4.text: Governance health metrics: partisipasi, waktu keputusan, kualitas paper, tingkat eksekusi keputusan → perbaikan siklus tahunan

233:233.5.text: Tests: delegation tak merusak tally, kelas proposal beda aturan ditegakkan, eksekusi butuh hasil valid + safety review, `governance:audit` clean

233:233.6.text: Edge case: proposal dibatalkan saat voting berjalan → status dicatat, tak dihitung sebagai hasil

233:233.7.text: Delegasi diam (tanpa pilih) ≠ abstain → perilaku tak bersuara didefinisikan terpisah

234:234.1.text: Venture pipeline: ide internal/startup → due diligence ringan → opsi (build in-house, incubate, JV Fase 51.2, investasi token) → stage gate funding bertahap (seed → series simulasi)

234:234.2.text: Incubation platform: aset bersama (marketplace, data, logistik, payment) disediakan ke venture → usage metering → cost/revenue share → tata kelola terpisah tapi terintegrasi ledger

234:234.3.text: Corporate venture portfolio dashboard: invested, valuation (mark-to-market periodik), strategic option value, kill/scale decision → exit (secondary sale token, acquisition sim)

234:234.4.text: Innovation funnel metrics: ideas → experiments → pilots → scaled → time & conversion per tahap → benchmark internal → investasi R&D berbasis funnel

234:234.5.text: Tests: funding staged tak melebihi approved, venture accounting terpisah lalu konsolidasi (Fase 52), kill decision menutup akses data, `ppm:audit` clean

234:234.6.text: Edge case: venture menjadi kompetitor internal → kebijakan non-compete & data isolation ditegakkan

234:234.7.text: Write-off venture → keputusan terdokumentasi, sisa nilai diakui di ledger

235:235.1.text: Capability-as-a-product: kemampuan platform (payment, identity, logistics, data, AI, loyalty) dikatalogkan sebagai produk internal → unit cost → chargeback/flywheel pricing → konsumen internal memilih

235:235.2.text: Internal API marketplace: tim lini menemukan & memakai capability lain tanpa build ulang → usage metering → quality SLA → feedback → roadmap capability

235:235.3.text: Build-vs-buy-vs-use decision framework: setiap inisiatif teknologi melewati framework (biaya, kecepatan, kontrol) → keputusan tercatat → review post-implementation

235:235.4.text: Platform adoption metrics: reuse rate, time-to-integrate, cost avoidance → dorong arsitektur monolith terpadu tetap dimanfaatkan penuh

235:235.5.text: Tests: chargeback = usage × tarif konsisten, capability SLA terukur, reuse metric akurat, `platform:audit` clean

235:235.6.text: Edge case: capability baru duplikat yang sudah ada → review wajib sebelum build, wajib pakai yang lama bila memadai

235:235.7.text: Sunset capability lama → consumer inventory + migrasi dulu, jangan matikan mendadak

236:236.1.text: Product ops: discovery (customer problem → hypothesis) → experiment design → build increment → release → measure → iterate → sunset → terhubung PPM (Fase 217)

236:236.2.text: Experimentation platform: A/B test deterministik (user bucketing by hash seed) → sample size & sequential test guard → metric terpisah dari noise → decision framework

236:236.3.text: Feature flag & release engineering: flag per environment → gradual rollout → kill flag instan → usage analytics per flag → tech debt retirement saat flag matang

236:236.4.text: Product analytics: funnel, retention cohort, engagement per lini → insight → roadmap evidence-based → link ke customer KPI (Fase 226)

236:236.5.text: Tests: bucketing konsisten & tak bias, flag kill efektif dalam 1 detik, experiment metric rekonstruksi, sunset menutup akses, `platform:audit` clean

236:236.6.text: Experiment preregistration: hypothesis, primary metric, sample size & stopping rule dicatat sebelum run

236:236.7.text: Guardrail: experiment tak boleh mengubah harga/eligibility kritis tanpa approval policy

237:237.1.text: Developer portal: environment provisioning (sandbox/staging), seed data snapshot, docs otomatis dari code (OpenAPI, events), changelog → kontribusi lintas modul mudah

237:237.2.text: Quality pipeline otomatis: lint → typecheck → unit → arch test → integration → security scan → performance smoke → deploy gate → setiap PR wajib hijau

237:237.3.text: Test data management: synthetic data generator (ber-seed), data masking untuk staging, referential integrity → test realistis tanpa PII nyata

237:237.4.text: Observability developer: distributed trace lintas modul (correlation id Fase 26.6), error budget per layanan → SLO → alert → postmortem

237:237.5.text: Tests: pipeline menolak merge saat merah, masking efektif (no PII in staging), trace lintas 2 modul utuh, observability coverage terukur

237:237.6.text: Edge case: test butuh data nyata → proses anonymization resmi, dilarang copy mentah

237:237.7.text: Coverage gap lintas modul baru → ditutup sebelum feature complete

238:238.1.text: Release train terjadwal (mis. mingguan) + hotfix path (approval terpisah) → release notes otomatis dari commit/flag → stakeholder notified

238:238.2.text: Change advisory: risk score per change (blast radius: money/PII/availability) → risk tinggi butuh CAB simulasi → rollback plan wajib → post-deploy verification

238:238.3.text: Database migration safety: expand-contract pattern, backfill idempoten di background, lint schema (tanpa breaking tanpa approval), dual-write bila perlu

238:238.4.text: Canary & blue-green simulasi: rollout bertahap → error rate monitor → auto-rollback → metrik deploy tercatat (change failure rate, MTTR deploy)

238:238.5.text: Tests: breaking migration ditolak lint, canary rollback otomatis saat error spike, release notes lengkap, rollback plan teruji, `platform:audit` clean

238:238.6.text: Edge case: hotfix mendadak → approval terpisah + post-merge review wajib sebelum normal train

238:238.7.text: Rollback data: schema yang sudah berisi data → expand-contract, tak bisa revert kasar

239:239.1.text: Performance observability per endpoint: p50/p95/p99, throughput, slow query, N+1 detection otomatis → regression gate CI (memperluas Fase 192.4)

239:239.2.text: Cost-to-serve per modul & per transaksi (infra simulasi: compute, storage, queue) → trend → hotspots → optimasi (query, cache, partition) → saving terukur

239:239.3.text: Capacity planning: pertumbuhan data & trafik 12 bulan → proyeksi → scaling plan (shard, read replica, archive) → capex/opex proposal ke Treasury (Fase 210.2)

239:239.4.text: Efficiency culture: performance budget per fitur baru (query & latensi) → review saat design → mencegah degradasi kumulatif

239:239.5.text: Tests: budget regresi gagal CI, cost attribution konsisten dengan usage, projection model deterministik, efficiency budget enforced pada template PR

239:239.6.text: Edge case: optimasi kinerja memperlambat write → trade-off ditimbang & dicatat keputusannya

239:239.7.text: Regresi biaya dari fitur baru → performance budget CI menangkap sebelum produksi

240:240.1.text: Design system lintas 30 lini: komponen, token warna/tipografi/spacing, pola (form, table, flow) → satu library → konsistensi visual & interaksi lintas modul

240:240.2.text: Accessibility standard (WCAG simulasi): keyboard navigation, contrast, screen reader labels → automated check CI → audit manual per rilis besar → remediation

240:240.3.text: Responsive & mobile-first governance: semua halaman uji lebar 375px (Fase standar diperluas 30 lini) → gate RouteSmoke responsive

240:240.4.text: UX research loop: usability test simulasi → temuan → backlog perbaikan → metrik task success rate → iterasi

240:240.5.text: Tests: component library dipakai modul baru (arch check), a11y lint hijau, responsive screenshot test pada sampel, research backlog tercatat

240:240.6.text: Edge case: modul butuh komponen khusus → request ke tim design system, review sebelum custom fork

241:241.1.text: Data governance council & stewardship: per domain (produk, pelanggan, finansial, medis, energi, komoditas) → data owner → policy (definisi, kualitas, retensi, akses) → enforcement

241:241.2.text: Data quality rules registry: completeness, timeliness, validity, consistency, uniqueness → runtime checks → DQ score per domain → bad data quarantine + owner ticket (memperluas Fase 146.5)

241:241.3.text: Lineage graph: column-level lineage dari source → transform → dashboard → keputusan → dampak analysis (ubah kolom → tahu siapa terpengaruh) → change gate

241:241.4.text: Data catalog & glossary: istilah bisnis tunggal (artikel tunggal per konsep) → semantik layer (Fase 146.3) → onboarding data baru wajib daftar

241:241.5.text: Tests: lineage completeness pada sampel, DQ failure membuat quarantine, glossary duplicate terdeteksi, steward approval wajib perubahan definisi

241:241.6.text: Edge case: data tanpa steward → tak boleh onboarding; ketiadaan pemilik = temuan governance

241:241.7.text: Lineage break saat refactor schema → CI deteksi consumer terpengaruh sebelum merge

242:242.1.text: CDC dari seluruh modul (via outbox Fase 26.7) → stream processing (window aggregation, enrichment) → real-time store untuk operational dashboards (Fase 190)

242:242.2.text: Stream quality: exactly-once semantics (idempotent consumer), ordering per key, late data handling → metrics: lag, drop rate → SLA per consumer

242:242.3.text: Event replay & time travel: rebuild agregat dari offset → verifikasi konsistensi dengan batch → mismatch = incident

242:242.4.text: Backpressure & degradation: saat stream lambat → prioritaskan event uang vs analytics → buffer policy → alert → tanpa kehilangan event moneter

242:242.5.text: Tests: replay menghasilkan state identik, lag alert terpicu, event moneter tak pernah drop pada simulasi overload, backpressure policy dihormati

242:242.6.text: Edge case: consumer ketinggalan jauh → resync dari snapshot, bukan streaming seluruh backlog penuh

242:242.7.text: Skema event berubah → consumer kompatibel lama dulu (Fase 509), baru versi baru

243:243.1.text: Graph analytics: jaringan (supply chain, distribusi, franchise, ownership, payment flow) → centrality, konsentrasi risiko, deteksi pola mencurigakan (money flow) → insight terverifikasi

243:243.2.text: Simulation & digital twin at scale (memperluas Fase 143.3): Monte Carlo simulasi risiko (weather, demand, outage) → distribusi hasil → VaR-like metrik per lini → keputusan berbasis probabilistik

243:243.3.text: Prescriptive analytics: optimization result masuk sebagai rekomendasi (Fase 199) + expected impact → A/B shadow → actual impact terukur → model diperbaiki

243:243.4.text: Research governance: eksperimen data → IRB-like review jika pakai data sensitif → ethical use checklist → publication/internal share policy

243:243.5.text: Tests: graph result deterministik, MC simulasi ber-seed identik, impact measurement tercatat, research approval wajib pada data sensitif

243:243.6.text: Edge case: simulasi menghasilkan rekomendasi ekstrem → sanity check + batas keputusan wajib

243:243.7.text: Model research pindah ke produksi → melewati review governance AI (Fase 195/360)

244:244.1.text: Data products eksternal: agregat pasar (harga komoditas, indeks footfall, benchmark industri simulasi) → subscription → API (Fase 147) → privacy kohort check wajib (Fase 189.3)

244:244.2.text: Data sharing agreements: mitra (kontrak Fase 28) → field-level scope → audit trail pemakaian → retention & deletion → compliance (consent & regulation bridge Fase 207)

244:244.3.text: Data clean room simulasi: dua pihak hitung bersama tanpa saling melihat raw data → hasil di-approve sebelum keluar → anti-re-identification check

244:244.4.text: Monetization accounting: revenue data product → COGS (compute) → margin → kontrak & billing via Payment → ledger

244:244.5.text: Tests: clean room tak membocor raw row, sharing scope enforced per-field, consent revocation memutus sharing, `data:audit` clean

244:244.6.text: Edge case: mitra menyalahgunakan data → akses dicabut + audit pemakaian + konsekuensi kontraktual

244:244.7.text: Data product dihentikan → consumer migrate + archive, revenue & COGS ditutup rapi

245:245.1.text: Pricing architecture unified: cost-plus, value-based, dynamic (Fase 81), contract, promo (Fase 44), tariff public (utilitas, parkir, port) → framework per domain dengan guardrail seragam

245:245.2.text: Elasticity & willingness-to-pay research: data historis + experiment → curve per segmen → price ladders → revenue lift terukur

245:245.3.text: Price governance: price floor/ceiling, approval matrix per margin impact, MAP/parity enforcement lintas channel (Fase 111.4) → violation → action

245:245.4.text: Profit pool analysis: siapa untung di mana (lini × segmen × channel) → strategi (grow/hold/harvest) → realokasi komersial → impact ke P&L

245:245.5.text: Tests: guardrail tak pernah dilanggar pada seed, elasticity deterministik, price change event idempotent, profit pool Σ = laba, `pricing:audit` clean

245:245.6.text: Edge case: harga anjlok tak wajar → circuit breaker harga → tahan perubahan → review

245:245.7.text: Perubahan harga massal → batch approval + notice period ke pelanggan terdampak

246:246.1.text: Sales process unified (B2B lini: asuransi, hotel corporate, MICE, PPA, colo, telekom enterprise, proyek EPC, jasa) → stage definitions → exit criteria → forecast berbobot

246:246.2.text: Account planning: strategic account map (multi-stakeholder), whitespace analysis, coverage model → activity plan → progress review

246:246.6.text: Edge case: forecast dilebih-lebihkan demi quota → model forecast independen dari input sales, tak bisa dimanipulasi

246:246.7.text: Teritory dispute → rule terdokumentasi + keputusan tercatat, tidak negosiasi diam-diam

247:247.1.text: KAM workspace: akun besar (kontrak multi-lini: grup hotel eksternal, operator telko, retailer, pemerintah simulasi) → cross-lini solution → deal room kolaboratif

247:247.2.text: Solution bundling engine: komponen dari lini berbeda → harga paket (tetap floor guardrail) → margin per komponen → settlement internal saat kontrak jalan

247:247.5.text: Tests: bundle settlement internal Σ = margin kontrak, SLA scorecard dari data nyata, share payout = formula, `ptn:audit` clean

247:247.6.text: Edge case: kontrak multi-lini batal di satu lini → impact ke bundle sisanya dihitung ulang, bukan semua batal otomatis

248:248.1.text: Bid desk enterprise: lelang dari pelanggan B2B/B2G lintas lini (supply produk, sewa, jasa, PPA, project) → qualification (bid/no-bid scoring) → resource assignment → timeline → submission

248:248.2.text: Bid cost accounting: biaya persiapan (engineering, legal, riset) → capitalize vs expense kebijakan → ROI bid terukur (win rate × contract value vs cost)

249:249.1.text: Unified CPQ: product/service catalog lintas lini (complex: bundel asuransi, paket hotel+event, kontrak telko, solusi EPC) → configurator valid → pricing → quote → approval → contract → order → fulfillment → invoice → cash

249:249.2.text: Quote lifecycle: versioning, expiry (timelock Fase 21.4), conversion rate analytics → konversi quote → order dihitung → bottleneck analysis

249:249.3.text: Order-to-cash unification: credit check (Fase 42.4 generalized) → order acceptance → fulfillment → delivery evidence → invoice → dunning → collection → cash application (Fase 209.3 bridge)

249:249.6.text: Edge case: credit check lolos tapi gagal bayar kemudian → escalation collection + blokir order berikut sesuai kebijakan

249:249.7.text: Revenue recognition vs cash mismatch → deferred/revenue schedule tercatat & direkonsiliasi

250:250.1.text: VoC aggregation: survey (post-interaction, NPS periodik), review publik simulasi, komplain, social listening simulasi → sentimen & tema terklasifikasi → closed-loop follow-up untuk promoter/detractor

250:250.2.text: CX journey mapping digital: journey utama (buy, stay, heal, learn, entertain) → instrumentasi step-level → drop-off detection → improvement backlog → impact measurement

250:250.3.text: Experience orchestration: personalization (Fase 112.5 generalized) lintas titik sentuh → konsistensi pesan → frequency governance → hasil terukur

250:250.4.text: CX financial link: korelasi NPS/CSAT vs retention/spend (model deterministik) → value of experience → investasi perbaikan diprioritaskan dari dampak

250:250.5.text: Tests: closed-loop tercatat sampai selesai, journey metric = agregasi nyata, personalization respect consent, correlation method tercatat, `crm:audit` clean

250:250.6.text: Edge case: NPS rendah tanpa follow-up → case terbuka otomatis, tak hanya tercatat angka

250:250.7.text: Korelasi ≠ sebab: laporan eksplisit menyebut korelasi, bukan klaim kausal tanpa uji

251:251.1.text: Plan-to-serve unification: S&OP (Fase 201) → planning jaringan (Fase 215) → procurement (Fase 33/82) → make (Fase 36-38) → move (Fase 22/80/177/179) → store (Fase 41) → sell (Fase 137) → return (Fase 79/174) → satu peta kontrol dengan KPI chain (OTIF, DOS, cash-to-cash)

251:251.2.text: Control tower eksekutif 30 lini: status chain live, disruption feed (Fase 53.6) → blast radius → rencana mitigasi → eksekusi via optimizer (Fase 199) → hasil terukur

251:251.3.text: End-to-end cost visibility: cost-to-serve chain per order (manufacture + move + sell + service) → identifikasi pemborosan → improvement project (Fase 217)

251:251.4.text: Tests: chain simulation penuh 90 hari semua audit 0 selisih, KPI chain = agregasi, mitigation execution tercatat, query budget tower terpenuhi

251:251.5.text: Edge case: chain KPI tak konsisten (OTIF naik tapi cash-to-cash memburuk) → review trade-off, jangan rayakan satu metrik

251:251.7.text: Supply chain ESG: emisi per shipment → link ke green shipping option (Fase 80.6)

252:252.1.text: Finance process unification: plan (budget Fase 54.1) → fund (Treasury Fase 187/210) → transact (AP/AR/payroll/billing 30 lini) → close (Fase 209) → control (Fase 203) → report (Fase 141.5/211) → tax (Fase 208) dalam siklus tunggal dengan checklist otomatis

252:252.4.text: Tests: angka management = statutory = ledger, checklist close wajib lengkap, shared service SLA terukur, `enterprise:audit` + `group:audit` clean

252:252.6.text: Shared service SLA breach → capacity review (bukan menurunkan mutu diam-diam)

252:252.7.text: Close task dependency: gagal di satu task → eskalasi sebelum lock terlanjur

253:253.1.text: Risk process unification: identify (register Fase 202) → assess (scoring) → treat (control Fase 203) → monitor (KRI) → incident bridge (Fase 204/206) → report (board pack Fase 231) → learning (postmortem masuk register)

253:253.2.text: Aggregate risk view: korelasi risiko lintas lini (mis. komoditas + FX + kredit pelanggan) → concentration & tail risk (simulasi MC Fase 243.2) → capital implication (Fase 157.3 generalized)

253:253.3.text: Assurance map: audit internal + eksternal + control testing + compliance → coverage map → gap dijamin → efficiency (hindari duplikasi audit area sama)

253:253.4.text: Tests: incident → register update otomatis, coverage map lengkap, aggregate risk deterministik, `risk:audit` clean

253:253.5.text: Edge case: coverage map menemukan proses material tanpa assurance → remediation sebelum sign-off

253:253.6.text: Incident → risk register update otomatis via event, tak menunggu review manual

253:253.7.text: Assurance sampler independen dari pemilik proses yang diuji (self-review dilarang)

254:254.1.text: Talent process unification: plan (workforce Fase 223) → attract (Fase 225) → select → develop (Fase 227) → deploy (gig Fase 85, mobility Fase 152) → perform (Fase 226) → reward (Fase 224) → retain/exit (Fase 225.4) → satu employee journey dengan stage gate

254:254.2.text: Skills-based organization: posisi didesain dari skill graph (Fase 227.2) → staffing (internal marketplace first) → gap → learning → deploy → productivity terukur → closed loop

254:254.6.text: Scenario automation → dampak ke skill requirement → trigger learning plan (Fase 227)

254:254.7.text: Journey completeness: setiap karyawan aktif punya stage saat ini + next action terlihat

265:265.1.text: Riset bersama universitas/institusi (Fase 106 bridge + Fase 218): proposal → ethics & IP agreement → funding tranche → data sandbox (Fase 244.3) → output (publikasi/paten)

266:266.1.text: Decision catalog: keputusan kritikal per lini (pricing, allocation, staffing, capital, risk) → owner → data & model dipakai → outcome terukur → review cycle

266:266.6.text: Outcome scoring: keputusan dievaluasi setelah jangka waktu → learning loop ke decision quality

266:266.7.text: Data sandbox tak boleh menyentuh data riil → enforced secara arsitektur

267:267.1.text: Domain-owned data products (Fase 189.1) dengan federated computational policy: setiap domain menjalankan policy engine sendiri (akses, quality, schema) → platform menegakkan minimum bar

267:267.2.text: Self-serve data platform: domain dapat publish product sendiri (template, CI policy, virtualisasi) → time-to-data product turun → metric terukur

267:267.6.text: Data product quality SLA breach → konsumen diberi notice + kompensasi/kredit usage

268:268.1.text: Formalisasi 4 level otonomi (Fase 143.2) per proses: level 4 (full autonomous + human audit sampling) hanya untuk proses berisiko rendah & terukur → daftar proses eligible → kontrol sampling 5%

268:268.2.text: Self-healing operations: anomaly → diagnosis (runbook terstruktur Fase 198.2) → remediation otomatis (restart, scale, failover) → post-incident report → tanpa downtime

268:268.3.text: Autonomous negotiation agent (terbatas): renewal kontrak berulang dengan guardrail harga → draft + compare → human sign-off pada nilai > ambang → learning dari hasil

268:268.4.text: Tests: level-4 process butuh audit sampling complete, self-healing tak menutupi insiden (tetap logged), negotiation tak pernah sign otomatis di atas ambang

268:268.5.text: Edge case: audit sampling menemukan pola salah → level turun otomatis ke supervised

268:268.6.text: Negotiation agent tanpa nilai sign otomatis → selalu butuh approval di atas ambang

268:268.7.text: Prosedur level-4 punya bounded blast radius terdokumentasi sebelum di-eligible

269:269.1.text: Synthetic data generator per domain (transaksi, sensor, perilaku) → ber-seed, privacy-safe (tak mem-copy PII asli) → dipakai test/training/analisis → quality check vs distribusi asli

269:269.2.text: Simulation marketplace internal: tim pakai simulator (demand, grid, port, mine, health) → cost per run → result registry → hindari duplikasi riset

269:269.3.text: Counterfactual analysis: "apa jadinya jika harga naik 10%" → model terverifikasi → rekomendasi → implementasi via approval → impact review post-facto

269:269.5.text: Edge case: synthetic data lolos tapi merepresentasikan populasi berbeda → distribution drift check wajib

269:269.6.text: Counterfactual rekonstruksi dua run → identik, deterministik terbukti

269:269.7.text: Simulator cost terukur per run → masuk FinOps budget

270:270.1.text: Copilot per peran: dokter (suggestion diagnosis Fase 198 bridge), mekanik (diagnosis), dispatcher (rekomendasi rute), kasir (upsell), auditor (sampling suggestion) → AI menyarankan, manusia memutus, keputusan tercatat

270:270.2.text: Skill augmentation loop: review keputusan AI oleh manusia → disagreement rate per role/model → training material → model improvement proposal (Fase 195.4)

270:270.4.text: Tests: AI tak pernah auto-execute di role HITL, disagreement tercatat penuh, queue SLA terukur, bias post-review terukur membaik

270:270.5.text: Edge case: manusia menolak semua saran AI (disagreement rate 100%) → model/UX di-review, bukan dipaksa

270:270.6.text: Review quality diuji: sampel disengaja (honeypot) untuk mendeteksi review asal-asalan

270:270.7.text: Keputusan HITL tercatat dengan identitas reviewer → accountability jelas

271:271.1.text: Digital securities desk: penerbitan token ekuitas/utang (simulasi PSAK, Fase 162/71) → bookbuilding → allocation → secondary trading terbatas → corporate action → reporting

271:271.2.text: Investor onboarding digital: KYC/AML tiered (Fase 27.2 + 200.3) → suitability check → subscription → custody entry (wallet institutional) → statement berkala

271:271.6.text: Investor suitability change → suspend akses instrumen berisiko hingga review ulang

271:271.7.text: Corporate action notice period dihormati, tak ada eksekusi mendadak

272:272.1.text: Treasury on-chain (simulasi): stablecoin/vault management → multi-sig approval (m-of-n role) → policy engine (limit harian, allowlist destination) → cold/hot wallet split

272:272.2.text: DeFi pool simulasi: liquidity pool internal (token komoditas/poin) → AMM constant-product sederhana → fee → impermanent loss tercatat → risk limit

272:272.6.text: Multi-sig quorum tak tercapai saat darurat → break-glass procedure dengan post-review

272:272.7.text: Yield program ditutup → payout berjalan sampai selesai, tak dipotong mendadak

273:273.1.text: Sanctions graph screening: screening entitas baru + re-screen berkala + ownership chain (UBO) → hit confidence → escalation → blocking operational (transaksi & kontrak)

276:276.1.text: CI pipeline terpusat: improvement idea → DMAIC project (define, measure, analyze, improve, control) → owner → baseline → target → hasil terverifikasi finansial → standarisasi SOP (Fase 198.2)

277:277.1.text: Unified planning stack: demand (Fase 201) → supply network (Fase 215) → capacity (Fase 36.4 generalized) → workforce (Fase 223.2) → financial plan (Fase 54.1) → satu consistent plan number

277:277.2.text: Finite scheduling lintas sumber daya (mesin, orang, ruang, kapal, seat): constraint solver (Fase 199) → schedule → shop-floor execution feedback → reschedule trigger rules

277:277.3.text: S&OP cadence terintegrasi dengan financial close & capital cycle → plan-actual-review dalam kalender tunggal

277:277.5.text: Edge case: plan number berubah setelah sign-off → versi baru + approval, plan lama diarsipkan

277:277.6.text: Reschedule tak boleh melanggar hard constraint (jam kerja, kapasitas, permit) → diuji

278:278.1.text: Asset utilization framework: semua aset bergerak & stasioner (truk, kapal, pesawat, alat berat, CT scanner, kapasitas pabrik, kamar, seat, crane) → utilization, idle cost, revenue per asset-hour

278:278.5.text: Edge case: utilitas naik tapi revenue turun → net contribution menjadi ukuran, bukan utilization saja

278:278.6.text: Replace decision → financing approval (Fase 210) & budget encumbrance terlebih dulu

278:278.7.text: Aset sewa → opsi akhir sewa masuk perhitungan replace-vs-renew

279:279.1.text: Automation planning: per DC → pick method (man, AMR simulasi, conveyor) → kapasitas → biaya → ROI → phased implementation

279:279.2.text: Robot fleet management (simulasi): task allocation, traffic (zone reservation anti-tabrakan), charging schedule, failure → fallback manual → throughput KPI

279:279.5.text: Edge case: robot gagal di tengah wave → fallback manual + wave re-plan, SLA terjaga

279:279.6.text: Safety interlock: zona manusia+robot → kecepatan & area dibatasi, kegagalan → stop

279:279.7.text: Biaya automasi vs man-power → ROI terukur sebelum rollout lanjutan

280:280.1.text: Multi-outlet operations bible: SOP lintas 5.000 outlet resto, 5.000 hotel, 1.000 venue (service sequence, opening/closing, crisis) → versioned → training attested (Fase 167.4)

280:280.2.text: Shift playbook engine: demand forecast (Fase 75.1/201) → staffing plan → task board per shift → completion evidence → variance report

280:280.4.text: Tests: attestation wajib sebelum shift mandiri, mystery audit deterministik, grade = formula, playbook version immutable saat aktif

280:280.5.text: Edge case: mystery guest menilai buruk → action plan → re-audit; grade turun → dampak brand scorecard

280:280.6.text: SOP berubah saat shift berjalan → notice & acknowledgment, jangan tiba-tiba beda aturan

280:280.7.text: Multi-bahasa SOP untuk tenaga kerja lintas negara → versi tersinkron

281:281.1.text: Service level framework per segment (consumer, SMB, enterprise, government): janji layanan (respons time, resolusi, uptime) → kontrak/kebijakan → measurement → credit otomatis (Fase 216.2 generalized)

281:281.2.text: Channel parity: jawaban & harga konsisten lintas chat, app, store, call simulasi → knowledge base tunggal (Fase 198.1) → divergensi terdeteksi → correction

281:281.6.text: Handoff kecil tak kehilangan konteks → template konteks wajib, bukan "silakan hubungi X"

282:282.1.text: Community platform per lini (review, forum, Q&A) → moderation pipeline (auto + human) → guideline → escalation pelanggaran → trust score kontributor

282:282.2.text: UGC commerce: review terverifikasi pembelian → influence ranking → UGC-terkait penjualan teratribusi (Fase 222.4) → insentif kreator (poin ledger)

282:282.6.text: Live selling gagal (stok habis saat live) → auto-cancel & refund cepat dengan notice

282:282.7.text: Trust score kontributor → penempatan konten, anti-manipulasi rating

283:283.1.text: Coalition loyalty lintas industri (maskapai, hotel, retail, asuransi, telko simulasi): earning rules per partner → interchange fee model → settlement multi-issuer → liability governance (Fase 220.3)

284:284.1.text: Culture & values framework: perilaku yang diharapkan per level → assessment (360 simulasi) → gap → development → link promosi (Fase 226.4)

285:285.1.text: Occupational health surveillance: pemeriksaan berkala (terutama tambang Fase 94, pabrik, radiologi RS) → hasil medis ter-encrypt terpisah (vault Fase 144.2) → fitness-for-duty terbatas (hanya status, bukan detail)

286:286.1.text: Impact measurement framework: baseline/counterfactual, attribution, leakage/permanence risk → applies carbon, biodiversity, community, health, education projects

286:286.2.text: Independent verification marketplace: verifier qualification, sampling plan, evidence review, conflict-of-interest control, assurance statement → payout only after approval

286:286.8.text: Klaim ESG publik wajib melewati disclosure control (Fase 331), bukan langsung dari proyek

287:287.1.text: Asset geospatial climate exposure: heat, flood, storm, drought (simulasi layers) → risk score per site/asset → financial impact estimation (damage, downtime, insurance)

287:287.2.text: Adaptation measures: flood barrier, cooling, elevated DC, water storage, backup power → EPC project (Fase 63) → cost/benefit → resilience improvement tracked

510:510.2.text: Alert orphan event (tanpa consumer) & consumer tidak sehat (lag > SLA) → dashboard kesehatan spine

510:510.4.text: Event SLA classification: critical (uang/safety) vs advisory → retry/backoff/priority queue berbeda

511:511.1.text: Katalog API per modul: endpoint, method, auth scope, rate limit, idempotency wajib (mutasi), versi

511:511.2.text: Contract tests CI: response sesuai OpenAPI; breaking change pada versi aktif gagal build

511:511.3.text: Deprecation policy: sunset date, header `Deprecation`/`Sunset`, consumer inventory sebelum dimatikan

511:511.4.text: Consumer impact analysis: perubahan endpoint → daftar pemakai → notice period → migrasi terverifikasi

511:511.5.text: API changelog otomatis dari diff spesifikasi → notifikasi subscriber
