512:512.1.text: Error model RFC 7807: problem type, correlation_id, field violations, retryable flag → konsisten seluruh API

512:512.2.text: Pagination cursor-based, sorting multi-kolom, filter whitelist, envelope identik di semua modul

512:512.3.text: Idempotency-Key wajib untuk POST mutasi uang/booking/order → replay respons identik

512:512.4.text: Correlation ID menembus: HTTP → job → event → ledger entry → audit log (trace 1 klik)

512:512.5.text: Rate limit & admission control per scope (memperluas Fase 57B.4) ke seluruh API 30 lini

512:512.6.text: Tests: error shape seragam (contract test per modul); replay idempoten; correlation lintas 3 hop; limit 429 + Retry-After

512:512.7.text: Edge case: idempotency key kedaluwarsa → perilaku didefinisikan (re-execute dengan warning)

513:513.1.text: Replay suite: charge, hold, capture, release, refund, transfer, split settlement → ulang 3× key sama

513:513.2.text: Hasil deterministik: Σ ledger identik tiap replay; balance cache konsisten; tak ada double posting

513:513.3.text: Replay setelah failover region (memperluas Fase 396.1) → tetap satu kali eksekusi

513:513.4.text: Negative replay: key sama + payload beda → 409 conflict wajib (bukan eksekusi diam-diam)

513:513.5.text: Concurrent replay: 100 thread key sama → persis 1 posting, 99 respons idempoten identik

513:513.6.text: Tests: replay 3× = 1 effect; conflict payload ditolak; `bank:reconcile` bersih setelah replay storm

513:513.7.text: Risiko: idempotency store hilang saat failover → persist key bersama transaksi, bukan cache volatil

514:514.1.text: Inventaris workflow multi-modul (bundle, supply chain, claims, onboarding, recall) → happy/failure path per langkah

514:514.2.text: Uji injected failure di setiap step: compensation berjalan, state konsisten, tak ada uang menggantung

514:514.3.text: Saga timeout matrix: retry → escalate → manual resolve → semuanya teruji dengan bukti penyelesaian

514:514.4.text: Compensation safety: kompensasi tak pernah menghasilkan efek ganda (idempotent revert)

514:514.5.text: Saga observability: status instance terlihat ke user (progress) + owner saat stuck

514:514.6.text: Tests: no orphan state pada ribuan kombinasi failure point; reconcile 0 setelah chaos saga; timeout terdeteksi

514:514.7.text: Edge case: compensation gagal juga → jalur manual dengan checklist + approval, bukan loop tak berujung

515:515.1.text: Pemindaian: tabel/status menyimpan salinan kebenaran domain lain (stok di luar Inventory, saldo di luar Ledger)

515:515.2.text: Setiap temuan → hapus kolom duplikat → read dari sumber + cache ber-TTL bila butuh performa

515:515.3.text: Arch test diperluas: deklarasi system-of-record per tabel → violation gagal CI

515:515.4.text: Cache policy: data finansial/availability tak boleh stale > threshold → invalidation event-driven

515:515.5.text: Authority map dipublikasikan di ARCHITECTURE → review setiap penambahan modul

515:515.6.text: Tests: duplikasi terdeteksi pada seed; cache stale tak menyajikan data finansial; authority map lengkap

515:515.7.text: Risiko: penghapusan kolom duplikat merusak fitur lama → migrasi expand-contract + dual-read sementara

516:516.1.text: Retention policy per kelas data: ledger (permanen), transaksi (5 tahun), log (90 hari), telematik (hot/warm/cold), medis

516:516.2.text: Job retensi otomatis: archive → delete/anonymize dengan bukti eksekusi & checksum manifest

516:516.3.text: Legal hold workflow (memperluas Fase 291.2): hold memblokir disposal → scope by matter/party/date → release ber-approval

516:516.4.text: Ledger immutability: tidak ada jalur UPDATE/DELETE pada `ledger_entries` → enforced via DB trigger + arch test

516:516.5.text: Retention conflict resolution: retention expired tapi legal hold aktif → hold menang, dicatat sebagai exception

516:516.6.text: Tests: disposal di bawah legal hold ditolak; ledger mutation attempt terdeteksi; retention job idempoten & terdokumentasi

523:523.1.text: Uji isolasi massal: resource tiap domain × tenant/entity/party/region → cross-scope access = 403

523:523.2.text: Cakupan: API, export, search, event payload, notification, file URL (signed URL scope)

523:523.3.text: Probe otomatis harian lintas scope → alert saat ada celah (memperluas Fase 188.4)

523:523.4.text: Bypass pattern testing: filter param, ID guess, sort injection, pagination trick → semua ditolak

523:523.5.text: Multi-tenant row-level security: global query scope otomatis per model → arch test memastikan tak terlewat

523:523.6.text: Tests: zero IDOR pada ribuan kombinasi; probe harian hijau; bypass terdeteksi; export scoped

524:524.1.text: Field classification: public / internal / confidential / restricted (medis, biometrik, finansial, identitas)

524:524.2.text: Encryption at rest per klasifikasi, tokenization untuk analytics, masking di non-production

524:524.3.text: Access pattern review: restricted field hanya lewat vault service dengan reason logging

524:524.4.text: Data minimization: API response hanya field yang dibutuhkan consumer (bukan SELECT *)

524:524.5.text: Privacy review gate: modul baru menyentuh field restricted → design review sebelum implementasi

524:524.6.text: Tests: restricted field tak muncul di export umum; masking efektif di staging; akses tanpa reason gagal

524:524.7.text: Edge case: field classification salah (restricted dianggap internal) → scan periodik menemukan mismatch

525:525.1.text: Consent record: subject, purpose, scope, channel, granted/revoked, timestamp, proof hash

525:525.2.text: Revocation propagation: event → semua consumer berhenti dalam SLA → proof laporan per consumer

525:525.3.text: Processing tanpa consent proof (untuk purpose wajib consent) → block + alert

525:525.4.text: Consent granularity: per purpose (marketing, analytics, sharing) → bukan all-or-nothing

525:525.5.text: Consent renewal: consent lama > N tahun → prompt perpanjangan → kedaluwarsa → treat as revoked

525:525.6.text: Tests: revocation menyebar ke semua consumer pada seed; late consumer tak baca data lama; audit trail lengkap

525:525.7.text: Edge case: consent ditarik saat transaksi berjalan → data diproses selesai, tak disimpan untuk purpose lain

526:526.1.text: Audit dokumen lintas domain: gapless numbering per (entitas, jenis, tahun), checksum SHA-256, signature validity, expiry, retention, ACL

526:526.2.text: Dokumen sensitif (kontrak, medis, keuangan) → enkripsi at-rest + akses ketat + watermark simulasi saat preview

526:526.3.text: Numbering integrity: celah nomor terdeteksi → investigasi (deletion vs failure) → justifikasi tercatat

526:526.4.text: Signature verification: hash dokumen + timestamp + signer authority → valid/expired/revoked

526:526.5.text: Expiry enforcement: dokumen kedaluwarsa (lisensi, sertifikat, polis) memblokir operasi terkait → reminder + escalate

526:526.6.text: Tests: numbering gap terdeteksi; checksum mismatch terisolasi; expiry memblokir penggunaan; akses scoped

526:526.7.text: Edge case: dokumen revisi → versi baru, versi lama tetap accessible read-only untuk audit

527:527.1.text: Audit trail wajib mutasi bernilai: actor, apa, sebelum/sesudah field-level, waktu, IP/device, correlation, alasan

527:527.2.text: Append-only + hash chain untuk log material; pencarian admin per actor/entity/date/range

527:527.3.text: Coverage enforcement: setiap Action ber-impact punya log → dipetakan via test (bukan audit manual)

527:527.4.text: Log immutability: UPDATE/DELETE pada audit log terdeteksi (trigger) → alert security

527:527.5.text: Retention audit log terpisah (lebih panjang) + akses read-only untuk auditor eksternal

527:527.6.text: Tests: log tak bisa diubah; setiap mutasi uang punya log; coverage 100% action ber-impact; pencarian jalan

527:527.7.text: Edge case: log berisi PII → field-level redaction untuk viewer tanpa hak penuh

528:528.1.text: Taxonomy exception lintas 30 lini: teknis, data, bisnis, compliance, fraud, safety → kode standar + severity

528:528.2.text: Setiap exception → case: owner, SLA per severity, next action, linked entity, escalation path

528:528.3.text: Auto-close dilarang tanpa resolution code + evidence; reopen → alasan wajib

528:528.4.text: Exception grouping: pola berulang → temuan sistemik → CAPA (memperluas Fase 428.2)

528:528.5.text: Cross-domain exception: satu insiden menyentuh beberapa lini → single incident, sub-cases per domain

528:528.6.text: Tests: exception tanpa owner/SLA ditolak sistem; aging alert berfungsi; resolution code wajib; grouping idempoten

528:528.7.text: Edge case: exception crash loop (berulang tiap menit) → rate-limit + agregasi jadi satu case

529:529.1.text: Dashboard remediasi: critical/high findings per domain, aging, owner, due date, blocked reason

529:529.2.text: Critical finding > SLA → eskalasi ke lini atas + freeze fitur terkait (bila risiko moneter/safety)

529:529.3.text: Finding lifecycle: open → in-progress → fixed → verified (pihak berbeda) → closed; tak boleh skip verify

529:529.4.text: Duplicate consolidation: temuan serupa di domain berbeda → 1 root cause + banyak remediation

529:529.5.text: Risk-based prioritization: severity × exposure × likelihood → urutan kerja + kapasitas tim

529:529.6.text: Tests: aging calculation benar; escalation terpicu; freeze menghalangi operasi berisiko; verify ≠ open

529:529.7.text: Edge case: owner meninggalkan organisasi → reassignment wajib, finding tak boleh yatim

530:530.1.text: Jalankan penuh: pest 0 gagal/0 skipped, pint, build, arch test, SecurityTest, RouteSmoke, QueryBudget

530:530.3.text: Bukti tersimpan di AUDIT.md dengan timestamp, run id, environment, fingerprint hasil

530:530.4.text: Gate regression: hasil sebelum vs sesudah disimpan; degradasi metrik > toleransi → gate merah

530:530.5.text: Evidensi otomatis: artefak CI (junit, coverage, EXPLAIN) dilampirkan, bukan screenshot manual

530:530.6.text: Tests: gate failure membuat fase tak bisa ditandai; evidence wajib ada; run id unik per eksekusi

530:530.7.text: Edge case: gate gagal karena flaky test → quarantined + tetap wajib diperbaiki sebelum lanjut

531:531.2.text: Determinisme: dua run identik → fingerprint comparison (hash state akhir) harus sama

531:531.6.text: Tests: determinisme terbukti; audit bersih; run-id & parameter tercatat; metrik terekam

531:531.7.text: Edge case: simulasi gagal → checkpoint resume → hasil identik run penuh

542:542.1.text: Re-run seluruh audit domain pasca-remediasi → 0 selisih untuk semua

542:542.2.text: Perbandingan before/after hasil audit tersimpan (diff angka, bukan hanya status)

543:543.1.text: Perbarui CODEBASE (peta modul/event/owner), ARCHITECTURE (diagram handoff), DECISIONS (keputusan A), RUNBOOK

545:545.1.text: `migrate:fresh --seed` dari nol → seluruh gate tetap lulus dengan data non-kosong

545:545.4.text: Seed referential integrity: tak ada orphan FK, tak ada saldo negatif awal, tak ada party yatim

546:546.1.text: Jalankan seeder 2× berturut-turut → idempoten, tanpa duplikasi, tanpa collision unique
